statuses.label: Verified
statuses.description: Bit-exact or pixel-exact against the selected reference oracle; the checked-in gate passes.

statuses.label: Playable
statuses.description: Human-confirmed playable without a known blocking issue.

statuses.label: In-game
statuses.description: Reaches gameplay, but a crash, render, audio, input or save issue is documented.

statuses.label: Menus
statuses.description: Passes the title screen but does not reach main gameplay.

statuses.label: Boots
statuses.description: Reaches a boot/title sequence; no verified gameplay yet.

statuses.label: Runs (smoke)
statuses.description: Automated load-and-run sweep completed; no gameplay or visual verdict.

statuses.label: Nothing
statuses.description: Does not boot or shows no usable output.

statuses.label: Untested
statuses.description: Catalogued but not yet tested on the current build.
